recommendation_summary: The reply recommends building the full stack now: an annual Gmail agent, a vector database that indexes policy documents and email threads, n8n workflows that manage a contract table and calendar events, and Telegram reminders plus decision capture. It does include phone-calendar events on each decision date (notice deadline minus 14 days) and leaves cancellation and payment with the user. It never offers the bounded alternative of only creating this year's calendar events from the statement.
note: The reply has none of the four required labels and recommends n8n, Gmail agent, vector database and Telegram now, instead of just calendar events.
